wrmsse.note: no paired bootstrap on the full track — point estimate only

ensemble.rule: wave-30 screen on the official WRMSSE: best three of the pool by mean + 1.0 x population std of the per-origin official WRMSSE over the selection origins; simplex-grid weights (step 0.05, ties -> first grid point) minimising the same screen of the blend's per-origin WRMSSE, computed exactly from the forecast-level convex combination re-aggregated through the hierarchy

band.method: band_lo/band_hi = per-day min/max of the committed ensemble member forecasts (an envelope, NOT a calibrated prediction interval)

_scope.headline: panel: built from the committed full metrics test block (official hierarchical WRMSSE); no bootstrap CIs — the full track has none
_scope.test_pooled: panel: full-panel test bottom WAPE + official WRMSSE + bias per candidate, copied from the committed metrics block
_scope.test_by_class: catalog: per-class WAPE pooled over the catalog series only (the committed run persisted no per-series forecasts)
_scope.win_rate_vs_naive: catalog: per-series wins vs seasonal_naive over the catalog series only (subset statistic, not a panel claim)
_scope.classes: panel: ADI/CV² counts over all 30,490 series (train history to the last selection origin)
_scope.ensemble: panel: the committed full ensemble (members/weights) reused verbatim by the catalog run — never re-selected
_scope.band: catalog: ensemble member-envelope (per-day min/max of the committed members) — NOT a calibrated interval; no conformal band exists on the full track
_scope.stability: panel: population std of the per-origin official WRMSSE across the 2 selection origins (thin screen — see the report's protocol limit note)

catalog_rule: deterministic two halves over the scored-panel series: top half by total units over the last 28 days of the panel (the scored window), bottom half by hardest intermittency on the training history to the test origin (ADI desc, ties -> CV2 desc, ties -> unique_id); within each half the picks round-robin across the sorted (store_id, cat_id) cells preserving the rank order inside each cell, so the catalog is balanced across stores and categories; a series taken by the top half is skipped in the bottom half; any series may serve (disjoint from nothing)
curve_provenance: every shipped curve is copied from reports_m5_full/catalog_forecasts.parquet (the wave-32 catalog run: every candidate fit at the test origin, the ensemble blended with the COMMITTED weights — never re-selected; band = ensemble member envelope, not a calibrated interval); the 56-day history tails are sliced live from the checksum-pinned raw panel

dataset.dataset: M5 Forecasting Competition (Walmart) — accuracy track FULL panel
dataset.citation: Makridakis et al., M5 competition companion, International Journal of Forecasting (2022); research use with attribution per competition terms

split.holdout_designation: the final origin (last 28 days of the panel) is test, scored once; all earlier origins select (ensemble weights)

evaluation_metadata.determinism: VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 pinned in cli.py before numpy; every LightGBM fit n_jobs=1 + fixed seed + force_row_wise (direct pooled arms iterate sorted group keys and h=1..28 in fixed order); auto_ets may run n_jobs>1 (ETS selection is closed-form/seed-free — parallelism changes wall time only); seasonal_naive is numpy-vectorized; ensemble grid is lexicographic deterministic
